related.title: PPPoE：1492 與 1500 B 的協商邊界
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受可逆編碼與一致協商；不把本題轉義比例當固定協定稅率。 交接時須能核對：交付 ppp-octets.csv、編解碼往返測試與協商紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require reversible encoding and consistent negotiation; the escape fraction is not a fixed protocol tax. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver ppp-octets.csv, round-trip codec tests and negotiation records.
related.difference: 建立兩端MTU/MRU、底層容量與PPP-Max-Payload能力矩陣。
related.differenceEn: Build a matrix of both endpoints’ MTU/MRU, underlying capacity and PPP-Max-Payload capability.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
PPP非同步透明傳輸可轉義特定位元組；壓縮選項會改變框架預算，本題固定不壓縮。
教學基準：1000+2+2+2+2+50 = 1058 B；對照：1000+2+2+2+2+100 = 1108 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

PPPoE的PPP負載受Ethernet payload預算與協商能力限制；不能只把本機MTU提高。
教學基準：1500-6-2 = 1492 B；對照：1508-6-2 = 1500 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Asynchronous PPP transparency escapes selected octets; compression options alter framing, so this fixture disables them.
Teaching baseline: 1000+2+2+2+2+50 = 1058 B; comparison: 1000+2+2+2+2+100 = 1108 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

PPPoE payload depends on Ethernet payload budget and negotiated capability; raising local MTU alone is insufficient.
Teaching baseline: 1500-6-2 = 1492 B; comparison: 1508-6-2 = 1500 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 逐欄編碼20個/64前綴，按TLV邊界切分，不將前綴長度誤當位元組。
related.differenceEn: Encode20 /64 prefixes field by field and split at TLV boundaries without confusing bits with bytes.

IPv6可達性TLV中的前綴位元組取決於prefix length；可選sub-TLV會額外佔容量。
